The '''D'vouran amulet''' was a pendant made from a tiny device within a small crystal. It was used by [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] on [[D'vouran]] to prevent heself and her brother, [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak Arranda]], from being consumed by the planet. The amulet emitted a [[Force field/Legends|force field]] that protected the wearer and anyone directly touching the wearer. An amulet was discovered by [[Kevreb Bebo]] in the hidden [[D'vouran Imperial laboratory|laboratory]] which had been abandoned on the planet. He used it as protection for himself, but eventually gave it to [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]] upon her willingness to hear his story. Tash used the amulet to protect herself and her brother [[Zak Arranda/Legends|Zak]] by holding his hand.

When the Enzeen leader [[Chood]] was thrown into the [[Heart of D'vouran]], the planet consumed one of the amulets. The force field caused the planet to violently react, with the surface acting as molten material, consuming and absorbing anything it could reach.
